text:
maya: Heads up — I noticed a big jump in collector CPU when we enabled full-span retention for the routing-service traces. p99 export latency also climbed a lot.
jacob: Saw that on staging too. CPU up ~35% and occasional p99 spikes for request latency.
sophie: What sampling/batching config are we running?
maya: Currently 100% sampling for routing-service spans. exporter config is `batch_max_items: 200` and `batch_timeout_ms: 50`.
ravi: That explains it — volume increased without batching scaled. More spans = more kernel work + more exporter churn.
maya: Attached flamegraph (link) and brief `top` output. CPU hot loop in exporter flush path.
telemetry-bot: collector v1.12 deployed to staging — see deploy link.
jacob: Can we try increasing `batch_max_items` to 500? Might reduce syscalls.
sophie: We tried 500 earlier: CPU dropped but end-to-end p99 ingest latency went from ~100ms -> ~230ms for some hosts. Tradeoff.
elaine: What about sampling strategies? tail-based or probabilistic? 100% retention seems unnecessary for most traces.
ravi: Tail-based sampling needs maintaining state and can increase memory. Probabilistic (eg 10%) is cheap but may miss edge cases.
maya: Idea: adaptive sampling — high fidelity for errors/latency, lower fidelity for normal requests.
jacob: Agreed. Also consider dynamic batching: grow batch size when queue depth is high.
sophie: We should instrument exporter queue depth and add alerting. If queue_depth > 50 for >30s, throttle sampling or increase batch.
maya: Also worried about cross-host noise. Need host-tagged metrics so we can target the canary properly.
ravi: I can wire up a canary rollout: 10% of routing traffic goes to collector config with adaptive sampling + batch_max_items=350 for 2 hours. Rollback triggers: exporter_cpu delta > +15% OR p99 request latency delta > +20%.
elaine: Add an automatic dashboard panel for the canary: exporter_cpu, export_queue_depth, span_ingest_p99, dropped_spans.
jacob: We should also enable exporter retries and backoff: `retry_count: 3`, `retry_backoff_ms: 200`. Avoid silent drops.
sophie: Add annotations in Console to mark when config rolled out. UX note: make the rollout description include the exact config diff.
maya: FYI retention change to "full spans 7d" was overkill. For the canary, let's keep full spans 3d and spans-sampling index for 30d.
ravi: Created rollout policy in Console and a canary job — will start at 1769524056.
telemetry-bot: canary-rollout scheduled by ravi — job id: canary-1769524056.
elaine: I'll add Redwood Optimize evals to detect semantic drift if we drop sampling (prompt/eval suite).
jacob: Also add a quick cost model: token/ingest cost delta for full vs sampled spans over 30d window.
sophie: Good. After canary we should run a 24h widened test before full rollout.
maya: Thanks all. Meeting after canary to review metrics. :thumbsup:
